Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Component: Intercooler-intake manifold connecting pipe

  • Fault: The vehicle is underperforming.

  • Faults detected by the self-diagnostic system: P0299 (Turbocharger boost pressure – Insufficient)

    Cause: Damaged intercooler-to-intake manifold connecting pipe

• Action: Check the condition of the intercooler-to-intake manifold connecting pipe and replace it if necessary.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: It is also advisable to check the condition of the components adjacent to the intercooler-to-intake manifold connecting pipe, as damage to it may have caused further damage.
